other.help: Every other line of modernuo.json, by its own name. They have no plain label yet; change them only if you know what they do.

groups.name: Server
groups.help: What the server is called, where it listens and which game data it reads.

fields.label: Server name
fields.help: The name players see in the server list.

fields.label: Listens on
fields.help: Address and port the game listens on, one per line (127.0.0.1:2593). 127.0.0.1 is this computer only; 0.0.0.0 opens it to every network this computer is on.

fields.label: UO data folders
fields.help: The Ultima Online folders the server reads its maps and art from, one per line, first one first.

fields.label: Find its own public address
fields.help: On: the server asks the internet for its public address to send to players. Off on a server for this computer only.

fields.label: Public address
fields.help: The address sent to players when it is not found by itself. Leave empty to use the listener's.

fields.label: Answer ping checks
fields.help: Lets server lists and launchers check that the server is up.

groups.name: Expansion and maps
groups.help: Which era of the game the server plays, and which facets exist.

fields.label: Expansion
fields.help: The era the server plays. Changing it takes that era's features and housing from the server's own table and keeps your facets. Items and skills of a later era stay in an existing world.

fields.label: Felucca
fields.help: The original Britannia, with player killing.

fields.label: Trammel
fields.help: Britannia without player killing (Renaissance and later).

fields.label: Ilshenar
fields.help: The Third Dawn land.

fields.label: Malas
fields.help: Age of Shadows' land, with Luna and Umbra.

fields.label: Tokuno
fields.help: Samurai Empire's islands.

fields.label: Ter Mur
fields.help: Stygian Abyss' gargoyle land.

fields.label: Test center rules
fields.help: Lets players set their own skills and stats, as on the old test shards.

fields.label: Make an account at first login
fields.help: On: logging in with a new name and password makes that account. Off: only accounts made by staff can log in.

fields.label: Accounts per address
fields.help: How many accounts one internet address may have. Two clients on one computer are two accounts from one address.

fields.label: Players may change their password in game
fields.help: Gives players the [password command.

fields.label: Protected accounts
fields.help: Accounts nobody can delete, ban or lower in access, one per line (the owner's).

groups.name: Saves and backups
groups.help: How often the world is written to disk, and how many old saves are kept.

fields.label: Save by itself
fields.help: Saves the world on a timer. Off: only [save, Save now and a clean shutdown save it.

fields.label: Time between saves
fields.help: hh:mm:ss, at least one minute (00:05:00 is five minutes).

fields.label: Warn players before a save
fields.help: How long before a save players are told it is coming (00:00:00: no warning).

fields.label: Save folder
fields.help: Where the world is saved, relative to the server's folder.

fields.label: Backup folder
fields.help: Where old saves are moved to before each new save.

fields.label: Pack old saves into archives
fields.help: Compresses old backups into archives in the archive folder.

fields.label: Archive folder
fields.help: Where the packed archives go.

fields.label: Restart by itself every day
fields.help: Restarts the server at a set time each day. Off for a server the editor's run bar manages.

fields.label: Crash guard
fields.help: When the server crashes: write a report, back up the save and, if set below, start again.

groups.name: Game rules
groups.help: Rules that change how the game plays.

fields.label: Stat cap (total)
fields.help: The most strength, dexterity and intelligence a character can have together.

fields.label: Stat gain speed
fields.help: 1 is normal; 2 gains stats twice as often.

fields.label: Houses decay
fields.help: Houses nobody visits fall down after a while.

fields.label: Veteran rewards
fields.help: Rewards for how long an account has existed.

fields.label: Buff icons
fields.help: Shows active spells and effects as icons in the client.

fields.label: Chat
fields.help: The client's chat channels.

fields.label: Command prefix
fields.help: The character staff type before a command ([save).

groups.name: Players' programs
groups.help: Rules for the client and the helper programs players run with it.

fields.label: A client that fails the check
Talk to assistants (Razor, UOSteam)
fields.help: Asks a player's assistant program to turn off the features the server forbids.

groups.name: Movement
groups.help: How fast characters move, in milliseconds per step.

groups.name: Staff pages
groups.help: Where players' help requests go besides the staff in game.

fields.label: Discord webhook for pages
fields.help: A Discord webhook address; each help request is posted there. Kept in your secrets file, never shown.

groups.name: Email
groups.help: Email for crash reports and staff pages (email-settings.json).

fields.label: Mail server
fields.help: The SMTP server (smtp.example.com).

fields.label: Mail password
fields.help: Kept in your secrets file, never shown.

groups.name: CrowdSec
groups.help: Shares and receives bans for bad addresses through a local CrowdSec agent (crowdsec.json).

fields.label: Machine password
fields.help: Kept in your secrets file, never shown.
